page.overview:
Who is Marilyn Van der Klok?

Ray Van der Klok (husband) Lynda Van der Klok (daughter; deceased) Unnamed son

Marilyn Van der Klok is a character in the Halloween franchise. She was from Haddonfield, Illinois.

Marilyn Van der Klok is the wife of Ray and the mother of two children: a daughter named Lynda and a son. On October 31, 1978, Marilyn lost her daughter to Michael Myers and had her buried at Mt. Sinclair Cemetery on November 4, 1978. Category:Female characters Category:Mothers Category:Comic characters Category:Van der Klok Family
